identity.name: Scholar
identity.core_philosophy: Digital tools with the soul of a library. Technology that respects the writing process.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Enable font-feature-settings for 'soft' styling if available.

body.usage: Use for all UI text, paragraphs, and inputs.

mono.usage: Use for code snippets, word counts, and pricing figures.

spacing.scale: Tailwind default but doubled for layout containers (e.g., p-8, p-16, p-24).

textures.paper: Use the paper texture image for the writing area background.

layout_strategies.marketing: Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetric, large typography, generous whitespace.
layout_strategies.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). Sidebar navigation, clean content area, minimal distractions.
layout_strategies.writing_interface: Zen Mode. Centered column, max-width-3xl, hidden chrome on focus.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent/10 text-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.feature: bg-white border border-border/40 p-8 rounded-sm hover:border-primary/20 transition-colors
cards.pricing: relative overflow-hidden border border-border p-8 rounded-sm bg-white hover:shadow-float transition-shadow

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 py-3 transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50

hero_background.alt: Student studying in a grand library
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with overlay or side image.

icons.usage: Use thin strokes (stroke-width={1.5}) for a refined look.

general: Implement the 'Organic Swiss' theme: strict grids but warm colors.
Use the 'Fraunces' font for all headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Ensure the writing interface feels like a premium text editor, not a form.
Use the paper texture background for the main writing area to reduce eye strain.
For the pricing page, highlight the 'Student' tier with a subtle 'Tracing Beam' effect.

pages.landing: Hero section must use the library image. Focus on 'Academic Integrity' and 'Improvement'.
pages.dashboard: Clean, sidebar layout. Show 'Recent Assignments' and 'Usage Stats' in a bento grid.
pages.editor: Minimalist. Toolbar on top or floating. Focus on the text.

accessibility: Ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1.
All interactive elements must have :focus-visible styles.

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (shiny, neon, dark mode only).
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
